title: Fading Light of Autumn
description:
This artwork was created primarily in Houdini, with the exception of the trees, which were made using SpeedTree and later converted to USD, allowing for color variation. I used Houdini to add details to the heightmap and employed Solaris and Karma tools for the lighting, where I used noises to generate cloud-like shapes, achieving a more attractive illumination. Additionally, I populated the scene with grass using scatters. The rocks were procedurally modeled and complemented with some assets from Megascan to decorate the environment in a detailed and natural way.

This is my first project using this workflow, and while I'm pleased with the result, I still need to improve optimization to render animations efficiently.
